description: This file defines data structures, constants, and a class interface for retrieving process status information on a device, specifically for TR-069 device management. It includes process attribute definitions, a class for managing process data, and related documentation.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess
classes.description: A class providing an interface to retrieve device process information, including methods for accessing process attributes and managing instances.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_PID
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the PID of a process.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Command
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the command name of a process.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Size
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the memory size of a process.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Priority
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the priority of a process.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_CPUTime
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve CPU time consumed by a process.

methods.name: get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_State
methods.description: Getter API to retrieve the current state of a process.
